'''''Journal of Difference Equations and Applications''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published monthly by [[Taylor & Francis]]. Established in 1995, it covers research on theory and applications of [[difference equation]]s and [[Discrete system|discrete]] [[dynamical system]]s.<ref name="about">{{cite web |title=Journal of Difference Equations and Applications: Aims and Scope |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/gdea20/about-this-journal |website=tandfonline.com |access-date=October 30, 2025}}</ref> Its current [[editor-in-chief]] is Saber Elaydi ([[Trinity University]]).<ref name="about"/>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
*[[Current Contents]]/Physical, Chemical & Earth Sciences<ref name=ISI/>
*[[EBSCO Information Services|EBSCO databases]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[MathSciNet]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[ProQuest|ProQuest databases]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Science Citation Index Expanded]]<ref name=ISI>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/ |title=Web of Science Master Journal List |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |access-date=October 17, 2025}}</ref>
*[[Scopus]]<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title= Journal of Difference Equations and Applications |issn= 1023-6198 |access-date=October 30, 2025}}</ref>
*[[zbMATH Open]]<ref name=MIAR/>

According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2024 [[impact factor]] of 1.<ref name="WoS">{{cite book |year=2025 |chapter= Journal of Difference Equations and Applications |title=2024 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
